name: Creatine
description: Compound the body makes and gets from meat and fish; stored mainly in muscle (supplement: monohydrate)

note.lead: Not every trial found an effect.
note.text: In men with prostate cancer on hormone therapy, lean mass and strength did not differ between creatine and placebo.

bullets: **Stored mainly in skeletal muscle,** also heart, brain and testes
**Supplements raise muscle creatine:** up 22% after one week in a 1999 trial
**Broken down to creatinine,** which leaves in the urine
**Muscle energy** role described in lab and animal studies
Many small RCTs, mostly in men
Not developed or approved as a drug

notEstablished.text: DHT effect on hair or prostate

practical.pharmacokinetics: Stored in muscle; excreted as creatinine in urine

regulatory.text: Dietary supplement; not an approved drug
GRAS notice 931 for some foods: no questions

references: FDA, Response letter to GRAS Notice 931 (creatine monohydrate), Dec 2020
Volek et al., creatine in resistance-trained men, Med Sci Sports Exerc, Aug 1999
Wang et al., creatine and strength meta-analysis, Nutrients, Oct 2024
